comments.text: As I watch food tours from around the world, I can't help but wonder what global cuisine was like before contact with the Americas beginning in 1492. Outside of the Americas there were: no tomatoes, no potatoes, no pineapple, no chocolate, no corn, no chili peppers, no vanilla, no peanuts, no squashes ... the list goes on. Imagine!
